channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump’s Push for Deals With Russia Powers His Frustration With Ukraine
item.description: The series of recent steps by the president that seem to favor Vladimir Putin reflect his intensifying desire to normalize the relationship with Moscow even if it means further undercutting Ukraine.

item.title: NPR: DOJ charges 28 with voting crimes. And, TikTok ignored staff's child safety concerns
item.description: The Justice Department has charged 28 people in California with voting crimes as Election Day nears. And, TikTok staff raised child safety concerns with executives, who failed to act, court records show.

item.title: BBC News: No 'protective ring' and visiting rules too strict - key points from Covid report on care homes
item.description: From the shocking lack of PPE to restrictions on visitors - the key points from the sixth Covid inquiry report.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘Gay men keep my ego going – they message me all the time!’ Ed Gamble on Traitors, true love, weight loss and people-pleasing
item.description: As a Traitors obsessive, Gamble is in his element hosting its hugely popular companion show, Uncloaked. He discusses keeping the show’s secrets, edgelord comics and how he became known as a ‘mega wife guy’ Ed Gamble does…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Three months of PM Andy Burnham: Can he sustain the ‘hope vibe’?
item.description: The UK's new prime minister has made big promises and is a popular leader, but there is still talk of an early election.

item.title: Ars Technica: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
item.description: A single query is all that's required to find thousands of conversations listed by title.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Sexual Assault Is a Free Speech Issue
item.description: Mary Anne Franks has spent years fighting against online abuse. When people are abused with impunity, she says, the message becomes “We do not care about women’s voices.”

item.title: WIRED Science: The Physics Behind Tesla’s Flying Roadster
item.description: To understand how Elon’s new car hops, glides, and sticks upside down, we need to talk about friction and force.

item.title: WIRED Business: OpenAI Engineer Accused of Spying on Executives Ordered to Remain in Custody
item.description: A judge ordered Abdulrahman Alfozan to remain in custody, likening the Saudi government’s offer to secure the former OpenAI engineer’s release to a “blank check.”

item.title: The New Yorker: “An Unprecedented Case of Child Abuse”
item.description: In an L.A. criminal court, new details emerge about the mysterious couple who collected more than twenty babies through surrogacy.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Madewell Has Teamed Up With The New York Public Library
item.description: The denim brand’s new collaboration with the New York Public Library draws on the library’s archives.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The Perfectly Imperfect Vessels of Madeline Coven
item.description: The Bushwick-based designer uses animal hides sourced from her hometown of Albuquerque to experiment with form and light.

item.title: Fox59: IMPD: 27-year-old arrested following homicide on NE side of Indianapolis
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS -- A 27-year-old man has been arrested in relation to a reported homicide on the northeast side of Indianapolis earlier this month. According to officials with the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department…

item.title: Mirror Indy: Shop from Black-owned businesses at this free festival
item.description: Daptoberfest will feature music, food and art from over 150 Black-owned businesses at Warren Central High School Oct. 24. The post Shop from Black-owned businesses at this free festival appeared first on Mirror Indy .
